name: Elnaam
title: Father of David's Mighty Men
summary: Elnaam is mentioned in the Bible as the father of two of King David's brave warriors. His sons Jeribai and Josheviah served among David's mighty men, known as "the Thirty." Elnaam himself is not described with his own actions but is known through his sons' heroic service.

keyEvents.title: Elnaam's Sons Among David's Mighty Men
keyEvents.description: Jeribai and Josheviah, the sons of Elnaam, are mentioned in the list of David's mighty men who served him faithfully in battle.

keyEvents.title: The List of David's Mighty Men
keyEvents.description: In 1 Chronicles, a complete list is presented of the brave warriors who served David, including Elnaam's sons among the chosen ones.

keyEvents.title: David's Army Assembles
keyEvents.description: David gathered around himself a group of courageous and skilled warriors from all over Israel, including sons of men like Elnaam, who supported him in his kingdom.

keyEvents.title: David's Kingdom Strengthened
keyEvents.description: Through the loyalty of powerful men like the sons of Elam, David's kingdom was established throughout all Israel, in accordance with the Lord's word.
